task.description:
Produce design artefacts for OIDC-16 through OIDC-26 in Stream B (Stage 6.5).

Requirements to design in detail:
- OIDC-16: full lifecycle agent REST API over adapter for realms/users/roles/clients/federations/secret rotation with scoped auth checks.
- OIDC-17: idempotency key on all provisioning endpoints with ES-03-style dedup.
- OIDC-18: platform-level transactional semantics for multi-step provisioning with reverse-order compensation.
- OIDC-19: provisioning audit for every adapter call; redact secrets/passwords/MFA seeds.
- OIDC-20: dedicated per-agent service-account clients (client-credentials flow only).
- OIDC-21: zero-downtime token/secret rotation with overlap grace period (default 1h).
- OIDC-22: one-time bootstrap agent identity with manual re-enable path.
- OIDC-23: federation support (SAML/OIDC/social) pass-through config and JIT link.
- OIDC-24: configurable federated claim/attribute mapping (SHOULD).
- OIDC-25: provider readiness check integration into /health/ready semantics.
- OIDC-26: provider metrics (verification rate/latency, JWKS hit ratio, adapter rate/error) with realm+method labels.

For each requirement, create src/design/oidc-<NN>-<slug>.md including:
- Public function signatures + input/output types
- Data structures and persistence model
- Invariants and failure/rollback guarantees
- API route surfaces + auth scopes
- DB schema/index additions if needed
- Cross-module dependencies
- Testability hooks and observability points
- Risks/open questions

Reuse and extend patterns from existing OIDC design files, especially OIDC-14 and OIDC-15 for provisioning and safety semantics.
acceptance_criteria: All OIDC-16..26 requirements map to concrete design elements
Compensation and idempotency semantics are explicit and testable
Audit redaction and metrics labels are explicitly specified
Open questions are listed rather than omitted

result.summary: Produced design artefacts for OIDC-16 through OIDC-26 covering lifecycle API, idempotency, transactional compensation, audit redaction, agent service accounts, secret rotation, bootstrap identity, federation, mapping, readiness, and metrics.
